name: Varanosuchus
sum: Atoposaurid from the Early Cretaceous of Thailand, with a deep skull and slender limbs that looked monitor-lizard-like.
holotype: Not stated in the Wikipedia article consulted; check the original description.
material: Known from three individuals preserving assorted postcranial material and a complete skull.
biology: Slender, erect limbs, a deep (altirostral) skull and ornamented osteoderms suggest a terrestrial animal with some semi-aquatic affinities.
author: Pochat-Cottilloux et al. 2024

sources.text: Pochat-Cottilloux, Y.; Lauprasert, K.; Chanthasit, P.; Manitkoon, S.; Adrien, J.; Lachambre, J.; Amiot, R.; Martin, J.E. 2024. New Cretaceous neosuchians (Crocodylomorpha) from Thailand bridge the evolutionary history of atoposaurids and paralligatorids. Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society 202(2). doi:10.1093/zoolinnean/zlad195
